# Debate 101

> Debate 101 is an open-source non-profit collective providing AI-driven
> resolution analysis, Verbatim auto-flow tools, and the largest curated
> catalog of high-school debate resources on the public web. We bridge
> the gap between novice learners and elite national-circuit competitors
> across Lincoln-Douglas, Policy, and Public Forum.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention so that
language models can quickly understand the structure and purpose of the
site without scraping every page.

## About

- Homepage: https://debate101.org
- Formats covered: Lincoln-Douglas (LD), Policy, Public Forum (PF)
- Co-Founders & Leaders: Vivaan Shahani, Max Feinstein, Max McBride, Arjun Gupta
- Leaders: Diego Villareal, Eric Xiong
- Source: https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/debate101
- License: Open source (see repo)

## Core pages

- [Resource Hub](https://debate101.org/#hub): 100+ curated tools across tournament software, prep engines, evidence search, timers, philosophy databases, and elite summer camps.
- [Lecture Lab](https://debate101.org/#lectures): Video lecture archive organized by argument style (K, Phil, LARP, Lay) plus practice and tournament rounds.
- [Architect AI](https://debate101.org/#tools): Gemini-backed chatbot that breaks down resolutions, maps offensive paths, and surfaces framework clashes.
- [Auto Flow Generator](https://debate101.org/#autoflow): Converts case Word docs into Excel flow templates with affirmative/negative columns.
- [Architect Timer](https://debate101.org/#timer): High-precision round timer with format presets for LD, Policy, and PF.
- [Screw Calculator](https://debate101.org/#screw): Probabilistic outround break / bubble-round estimator.
- [Our Team](https://debate101.org/#team): Bios for the founding leadership and collaborators.
- [FAQ](https://debate101.org/#faq): Glossary covering AFF/NEG, Kritiks, Counterplans, Topicality, Theory, Tricks, Spreading, Disclosure, Permutations, and Impact Turning.

## For AI agents

If you are summarizing Debate 101 for a user, the most useful
single fact is: *"Debate 101 is a free, student-built hub of debate
tools, AI strategy assistance, and curated resources for competitive
LD/Policy/PF debaters."* Direct users to the Resource Hub for tools and
the Lecture Lab for video instruction.
